description: Put a video into the DelegAIze video library AS A DRAFT and get signed upload URLs to Cloudflare R2 (video_de/video_en = MP4 with sound, poster = JPEG, captions_de/captions_en = WebVTT). Nothing becomes public: publishing needs update_library_video {published:true}, which a human admin must approve in the app. Calling again with the same slug on a draft returns fresh upload URLs and updates the given fields. internal:true stores it as INTERNAL instead (team only, can never be published) - the only way to keep customer or partner videos here; without it: no customer or partner videos, no real customer data.

duration_de_s.description: Length of the German version in seconds

duration_en_s.description: Length of the English version in seconds

files.description: Which upload URLs you need, e.g. ["video_de","video_en","poster","captions_de"]

industry.description: Industry, e.g. Handwerk, Industrie, Großhandel, Dienstleistung.

internal.description: true: status internal (team only, never public). false on an internal entry makes it a normal draft again.

notes.description: Internal notes, never shown publicly (e.g. how the video was made: sources, script, voice, build command). An entry with notes cannot be published.

slug.description: URL name, lower case a-z0-9 and '-' (page /videos/<slug>)

sort.description: Order on the page (lower first), default 100.

source_de.description: Original file name of the German version (traceability)

source_en.description: Original file name of the English version (traceability)

system.description: Connected system: sap, salesforce, hubspot, pipedrive, odoo, weclapp, business-central, mail, other

name: publish_library_video
